Reflection Effect

Add a realistic mirror reflection under your photo with a smooth fade — adjustable height and gap.

The reflection is flipped artwork with a gradient fade — rendered locally in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a photo.
  2. Drag the reflection height slider to set how tall the mirror image is.
  3. Adjust the gap and fade to taste.
  4. Click "Download image" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the reflection made?

The reflection is your photo flipped vertically with a gradient mask that fades it out, plus a subtle darkening for realism.

How do I make the fade longer?

Increase the fade height or lower the start opacity for a longer, softer reflection.

Is my photo uploaded?

Yes — everything is rendered on a canvas in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
